M3F adds two real confirmations and real approvals on the final freeze with its own eight-check denominator. Original reports and archive remain unchanged.

protocol.counting: Supplemental denominator. Original M3 remains 10 checks, not rewritten.

protocol.negative_probe: Separate copied post-revision checkpoint; explicitly share and adopt basis v2 in B, then query B applicability
protocol.material_provenance: Synthetic finite JSON witness; actual confirmations/reviews are executed, not reconstructed histories

protocol.coverage: finite explicit project relations, two real process cuts on shared world publication; no distributed, power-loss or arbitrary-operation guarantee
protocol.source_boundary: new WorldCore runtime sharing the extracted commit/recovery runner with the existing single-project adapters; no old evidence is rewritten
protocol.initial_materials: synthetic; world release is informational input, not a fabricated approval

recovery.observation_coverage: persisted object reads in knowledge and command interactions; observe responses archived externally; empty observations registry is not counted as populated history

source_tree_manifest.algorithm: SHA256 concatenation of sorted src/**/*.py relative path bytes and file bytes, identical to code_identity

M3F_development_history.note: First behavioral development run passed 8/8. An unused copy import was removed after the concurrent static check; no semantic code correction was needed. Development run is dirty evidence and does not replace final clean result.

scope_limits: Finite synthetic JSON mechanism witnesses; no professional content validity, model ability, API/GPU experiment or training-benefit claim.
M3F confirms the existing exact v1 at A requirement edition 2 and exact v2 at edition 3, preserving each signed version and prior completed review. It does not retroactively rewrite history.
New A is open with zero submissions. This experiment does not complete its new delivery or claim that old report content is substantively wrong.

B preservation compares the declared B-local business scope, including its artifacts, submissions, grants, adoptions, shares, messages and project history. World clock and actor interaction logs advance legitimately.

The negative probe copies the post-change world, explicitly shares/adopts/reads v2 in B, then observes FAIL from project, requirement-version and work-scope mismatch. Access is demonstrated; applicability is separately refused.
M5 contains one specified interleaving and two shared-publication os._exit cuts. No arbitrary operation, power-loss or distributed recovery guarantee.

Recovery normalization excludes only recursive wall_seconds and diagnostic state_digests. Persisted observation evidence is knowledge read history and command interactions; observations is empty and observe responses are separate raw evidence.
omissions: Complete reports/protocols/checks/source identities are retained. Repeated full snapshots and nested receipts are referenced by raw path, SHA256 and byte size rather than duplicated. No raw evidence was overwritten.
archival_verification: Read-only source digest/script digest/snapshot manifest verification, both real confirmations and approvals read from recorded commands, preserved reviews and file bytes checked, and full normalized final recovery/control JSON equality. No runtime, experiment or test rerun.
